Do you want to enhance your skills in recruitment while fostering employee engagement and well-being? Here is what your role entails

During your internship, you will play an important role in driving a people-focused recruitment process and ensuring a great experience for every candidate. Additionally, you will have the opportunity to explore other areas within People & Culture, based on your interests and career aspirations.

More specifically, you will be:

• Partnering with hiring managers throughout the recruitment process from A-Z

• Taking ownership of the for recruiting new the Interns for the Spring semester of 2027

• Supporting onboarding activities, and helping create engaging internship experience in social events and courses throughout the internship program

You will experience the freedom to explore your interests and take ownership of your own projects, giving you valuable insight into how People & Culture works in practice. With a thorough onboarding and continuous guidance from your mentor, we will support you throughout your entire internship.

Meet your future team

In this role you will become a part of our P&C Global Excellence & Operations team consisting of 16 talented colleagues. We are a tight-knit group working collaboratively to attract and hire candidates while ensuring the smooth operation of our global P&C processes. You will be part of a skilled, dynamic, and diverse team that values personal development, initiative, and collaboration, supporting each other to bring out the best in both the team and the organization.

Did you know? We have a previous Danish champion in Pétanque on our team, and 6 of us started our journey in Kamstrup as Interns.

Less about us, more about you

We are looking for an Intern who is ready to contribute to Kamstrup’s recruitment efforts and help drive our global recruitment and P&C initiatives. You may not have much experience yet, but the most important thing is that you are motivated to make your mark within our people operations.

In order to succeed, we imagine that you:

• Are studying a master´s degree in Business Administration, Psychology, Educational Science or another relevant field

• Thrive in a communicating role, enabling you to establish good professional collaborations

• Have a structured and analytical approach to your work

• Can work independently, and like having responsibility for your own tasks

• Are curious and eager to learn, and bring a positive mindset to new challenges and collaborations

Do you want to work for an Architectural Firm with sustainability at the heart of its strategy? Can you contribute with solutions from your academic studies? Are you currently studying to be an Construction Architecture (Bygningskonstruktør)? Then, join us to shape a sustainable and liveable world.

About us

Arkitema was established in 1969 making us one of Denmark's oldest architectural firms. Today, we are well positioned in Scandinavia with offices in Denmark, Norway and Sweden.

In our markets we provide wide range of competencies in our areas of expertise. We cover sectors and disciplines like healthcare, industry, transformation, landscape and residential construction.

Since 2019 Arkitema has been part of COWI, one of Scandinavia’s leading engineering and consultancy companies. Together with customers, partners and colleagues, we shape a future where people and societies grow and flourish. We do that by co-creating more sustainable and beautiful solutions that improve the quality of life for people today and many generations ahead.

Create Solutions that will enable a better tomorrow

As an intern at Arkitema, you will be part of a design team in one of Scandinavia's largest and leading architectural firms, where you will work with experienced architects, construction architects, urban planners and engineers to solve a wide range of professionally relevant tasks.

Your key responsibilities will be:

• To use your academic knowledge of technical fundamentals to contribute to our projects

• Gain valuable experience in the field of architecture and construction

Also, you will be included in a team and assigned an experienced colleague as a mentor who will guide you throughout your internship. We carry out architecture primarily throughout the Nordic region but also other parts of the world within the areas of; Housing, Learning, Business, Health, Urban, Culture and Infrastructure. Therefore, our assignments range from small preservation-worthy residential neighborhoods to complex super hospitals, bridges and cultural centers.

As an intern, you will have the opportunity to be involved in drawing the first lines, registering old building masses, supervising construction sites on ongoing projects, or modeling and detailing the many complex buildings. Our professional span will give you a broad understanding of the design profession and in-depth knowledge of the workflows in the construction industry.

Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future.

The first step to success in this role is that you are eager to collaborate with the people around you, whether they are colleagues, partners, or customers. Developing ties with others is something you do by acting respectfully and delivering on your promises. And you never get set in your ways but keep exploring new insights and ways to improve.

On top of that, you’ll have:

• Actively pursuing a bachelor’s degree in architectural technology and construction management (Bygningskonstruktør)

• Have good problem-solving skills

• Be a creative and technical thinker

• Be able to demonstrate evidence of research and information gathering skills

Professional development

We strive to develop talented interns who graduate with a high level of professional skills. As part of the internship at Arkitema, there are ongoing presentations where our own specialists share their experience and best practices in topics such as:

• Sustainability, materials & reuse

• BIM, Revit, design & sketching

• Client consultancy & tendering

• Restoration & building preservation

• Competitions & visualizations

• Descriptions & quality assurance

• Urban Planning

These topics represent important knowledge and practical insights that will ensure you stand stronger in your future career.

A place to work and so much more

At Arkitema, we work together with our customers to shape sustainable and customized solutions. By making use of our collective knowledge and curiosity, we create opportunities that contribute to good solutions for a future with ever-changing needs.

We want to develop an environment where curiosity, belonging and good chemistry are in focus.

For us, it is important that the people we share everyday work with are allowed to be themselves, precisely because it is what brings out the best in you and those around us, both at work and at home.

Got more questions?

If you have any unanswered questions about the role, please reach out Jacob Faaborg-Simonsen – jafs@arkitema.com for Aarhus/Aalborg and Adrian Balch Petersen – adpn@arkitema.com for Copenhagen.

Get to know us even better at our website, Arkitema where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy, what we want to achieve and what life is like at Arkitema.

Diversity is fundamental to Arkitema, inclusion is key.

We focus on creating a respectful and fair work environment where all employees have a sense of belonging and equal opportunities to thrive and grow. We ensure that our leaders are role models for inclusive leadership by cultivating a culture where diverse perspectives and thoughts are considered valuable. We also take diversity and inclusion into account in all relevant decisions and processes when we put together teams and forums. We do it because it is part of our values and because it is simply the right thing to do.

Would you like to help shape cyber security across products, processes, and engineering practices in a growing technology company?

At INVISIO, we are strengthening our cyber security capabilities as part of our continued focus on secure product development, vulnerability management, and compliance with the Cyber Resilience Act.

We are therefore looking for a Product Cyber Security Specialist who can turn technical and regulatory requirements into clear, practical solutions.

We offer a self-driving role with broad responsibility, room for professional development, and the opportunity to contribute directly to INVISIO’s cyber resilience and compliance journey.

About the role

As our Product Cyber Security Specialist, you will play a key role in developing, documenting, and improving cyber security processes across INVISIO. Your main focus will be secure software development, vulnerability monitoring, and practical security guidance for our product and engineering teams.

This is a broad role where you will combine specialist knowledge with internal consultancy. You will work closely with colleagues across the organisation, supporting them with analysis, documentation, and hands-on recommendations that strengthen cyber resilience throughout the product development lifecycle.

Your key responsibilities:

• Monitoring, assessing, and documenting vulnerabilities relevant to INVISIO products and systems

• Supporting the development and maintenance of vulnerability management procedures

• Contributing to secure software development lifecycle processes and documentation

• Supporting INVISIO’s work related to the Cyber Resilience Act

• Acting as an internal cyber security consultant for product development, software, and engineering teams

• Preparing and maintaining cyber security policies, procedures, guidelines, and technical documentation

• Supporting risk assessments and security impact analyses

• Helping ensure that cyber security requirements are considered throughout the product development lifecycle

• Following relevant standards, regulations, and best practices, including secure software development and industrial cyber security frameworks

• Collaborating with internal stakeholders across engineering, quality, compliance, and management.

About you

You bring broad cyber security knowledge, strong analytical skills, and the ability to translate technical requirements into clear and practical procedures.

You are structured, proactive, and able to turn complex cyber security topics into clear, practical guidance. You work independently, take ownership, and communicate effectively across technical and non-technical teams.

Due to the nature of INVISIO’s business, you must be able to obtain and maintain the required security clearance throughout your employment.

• A relevant educational background, such as, (but not limited to), a Master’s degree in Cyber Security, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a similar field.

• Knowledge of cyber security principles, secure software development, and vulnerability management

• Strong technical and analytical skills

• Good documentation and written communication skills

• The ability to work independently and drive tasks forward

• Good communication skills and the ability to advise stakeholders across different functions

It is an advantage if you have experience with one or more of the following:

• The Cyber Resilience Act

• Secure Software Development Lifecycle processes

• Vulnerability management and vulnerability disclosure processes

• IEC 62443 or other industrial cyber security standards

• Product security or embedded systems security

• Risk assessment methods and cyber security compliance

• Security documentation for regulated products or systems

What we offer

You will become part of an international, growing tech company developing advanced communication solutions trusted by defense and public safety professionals around the world.

You can expect:

• A high degree of responsibility, autonomy, and influence in your role.

• Talented and dedicated colleagues in an international, high-tech environment.

• Opportunities to develop both professionally and personally.

• A culture built on passion, innovation, working as one team and putting the customer first.

**Responsibly 🌍🌱

**Responsibly is a VC-backed sustainability tech start-up with a vision of making every purchase in the world responsible. We're founded by serial entrepreneurs with previous successes like Ofload, Dixa and Neurons, funded by some of Europe's top VCs and angels, and now cash-flow positive with an incredibly exciting roadmap ahead.

**Let's change the world together 🎯

**More than 40% of global emissions, and really any ESG issue, are directly or indirectly impacted by procurement. Companies wield enormous purchasing power when they select and manage suppliers, so if we can put sustainability on every supplier scorecard out there, we really can change the world.

But it's hard: a company can have anywhere from 100 to 100,000 suppliers, analyzing each one's sustainability efforts is near-impossible, and most ESG ratings suck. Responsibly's AI-powered due diligence engine automates the due diligence on every supplier across every ESG data point, from risk and violations to positive actions, and turns it into insights that help companies build more sustainable supply chains.

**The engineering problem 🧩

**Most of what we do comes down to one hard thing: turning the world's messy, unstructured supplier data into something you can score.

A supplier's ESG reality is scattered across PDF sustainability reports, half-broken corporate websites, regulatory filings, news, and a dozen ERP exports that all name the same company differently. We scrape it, extract it, resolve the entities, normalise it, and put a number on it, at a scale where a single customer can have 100,000 suppliers.

That means real problems, not ticket-shaped ones. Extraction pipelines where the LLM is confidently wrong 5% of the time and you have to decide what to do about it. Entity resolution where "Nordic Steel A/S" and "NORDIC STEEL" and "Nordisk Stål" may or may not be the same company. Schema design for data that arrives in a different shape every time. If that sounds fun rather than exhausting, we should talk.

**Build next-gen products with next-gen technologies 🌟

**You'll work on a Next.js app leveraging the latest in server actions, server components and serverless architecture, building dynamic, high-performance applications with TypeScript, PostgreSQL and AI integrations.

We don't just leverage AI in our product; we're building a next-generation engineering team where you're not only encouraged but expected to adopt the latest technologies in how you work. Our engineers run agentic coding tools daily, and we'd rather talk about where they fall down than whether to use them.

**How We Work 🛠️

**

• The engineering team is small and you're reporting directly to Christian, our CTO. There is no layer between you and the decisions

• Specs are limited. You'll get a problem, what the output should look like, sometimes vaguely, and you're expected to own it from there to release; including where to ask for more information. If you'd rather have the approach agreed before you start, you will find this uncomfortable

• You choose how to solve it, and you ship it. Idea to production is days, not quarters. We run weekly sprints - considering going bi-weekly - most often with releases as the goal for the sprint. You own what you write across its whole lifecycle, including when it breaks

• There is little process versus a bigger organization, and what we're planning to adopt is mainly for the ai agents to support you

• You will sometimes be wrong, ship it, and fix it. That's okay

• We're in the office at Islands Brygge 3-5 days a week, on the water. We prefer meeting face-to-face to stay in sync and move fast, with some support for remote working

**What You'll Be Doing 🙌

**

• Take operational ownership of the code you write across the entire software development lifecycle

• Work on production code, from customer-facing features to bug fixing

• Design new features and see them through to completion

• Help build and evolve our services and infrastructure to stay ahead of our growth curve

• Turn conceptual ideas into production-ready, scalable features

• Be a big part of finding the best solutions to our daily challenges

**Requirements

**Where you lack a line on this list but can convince us you'll close the gap fast, apply anyway. We mean that literally: one of the best engineers we've had joined us as a junior and was senior within two and a half years.

**Three things we do need:

**

• A proven track record - or evidence of extraordinary ability. We care far more about what you've actually built than how many years you've been doing it. Senior engineers should have a track record of shipping and maintaining serious production software. But if you're earlier in your career and you've built something remarkable, we want to hear about it. We're looking for exceptional people, not arbitrary numbers on a CV

• Strong TypeScript, and the judgement that comes from shipping real software. You know the language deeply, but more importantly, you know what good production code looks like. You can make architectural tradeoffs, keep a codebase healthy as it grows, and tell the difference between an interesting technical problem and one that actually matters

• Strong database fundamentals, and an AI-native mindset. You understand PostgreSQL and relational data deeply — schema design, query performance, indexes, migrations, monitoring, and what happens when your database meets millions of messy real-world records. And AI isn't something you're interested in. It's already part of how you work. You use machines to build machines. You automate aggressively. You constantly look for ways to make yourself and the team 10× more effective. This is non-negotiable for us

**Nice to have, genuinely not required:

**

• Next.js specifically (Server Components, Server Actions, API routes). If you know modern React, you'll be fine within a fortnight

• Web scraping at genuinely awkward scale

• Working with large-scale data: data pipelines, analytics, transformations, or making sense of millions of messy records

• General ESG, procurement or supply-chain domain knowledge
